enrichment.core_claim: Anesthetics may act through caveolae membrane microdomains that coordinate lipids, mitochondria, and cytoskeleton, unifying how cells switch between conscious and unconscious states.
enrichment.ask_question: What do caveolin knockout mice show in anesthetic sensitivity so far?
enrichment.challenge_question: How would the caveolae model explain anesthetic potency differences better than direct protein binding accounts?
